messages:
auditor_jan: Hi team — follow-up from the audit: we need binding evidence for an RBAC change to the service account inference-gateway on 2025-02-10. Specifically: (1) the change record/PR, (2) the deployment timeline, (3) KMS decrypt events for key alias/rdw-inference-key for that window, and (4) any vuln triage notes that motivated or followed the change. Where should I pull these from?

mike_oncall: @auditor_jan short answer: PR + CI + CloudTrail. Long answer: we have a packaged export process.

elaine_infra: PR is github.com/redwood/inference/commit/2f9b7a4 (PR #4567). Deployment pipeline ran around 2025-02-10T18:22Z via CircleCI -> k8s rollout.

sam_sec: For KMS decrypt events, you can pull CloudTrail entries with eventName=Decrypt and requestParameters.keyId=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/rdw-inference-key for 2025-02-10T18:00:00Z..2025-02-10T19:00:00Z. Splunk query we used: 
```
index=cloudtrail eventName=Decrypt "rdw-inference-key" | table _time, userIdentity.principalId, sourceIPAddress, requestParameters
```

auditor_jan: Thanks. Will the CloudTrail output include ciphertext blob metadata we can use to link to the request? We need to prove the service account triggered it, not just the node.

sam_sec: CloudTrail has userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer and principalId for the IAM role assumed. For our k8s flow the principal shows up as `arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/redwood-inference-node/spot-xyz` but the requestParameters includes `encryptionContext` we set with `service_account=inference-gateway`. So yes, that ties the decrypt to the service account.

elaine_infra: Also the CI run writes an audit artifact: `deploy-manifest-20250210-1822.json` stored in s3://redwood-audit/ci-artifacts/2025/02/10/. It contains the image digest, git sha, and applied k8s manifest which references the serviceAccount name.

auditor_jan: Perfect. Can you package these into a single evidence bundle and include a short narrative mapping these artifacts to the control IDs (SOC2 CC6.1 / ISO A.9) and indicate any residual gaps?

mike_oncall: On it. I'll run the exporter: `redwood-audit export --range 2025-02-10T18:00:00Z/2025-02-10T19:00:00Z --keys rdw-inference-key --include-ci --include-cloudtrail --output s3://redwood-audit/evidence/1746051234-bundle.tar.gz`

security-bot: Evidence export started by mike_oncall. Job ID eexp-8c9a.

sam_sec: For vuln triage notes: see internal ticket INFR-991 (linked in PR #4567). Summary: minor dependency bump to grpc due to CVE-2025-0123, no exploit in prod, applied mitigation and monitored for 72h. I'll add a one-paragraph summary to the bundle.

auditor_jan: For the narrative mapping, can you list the exact artifacts and the authoritative location for each (S3 path / GitHub link / CloudTrail query) so we can reference them in the audit report? Also, any redaction applied?

elaine_infra: Artifact list I'll include: 1) PR #4567 (github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4567) 2) commit 2f9b7a4 (github.com/redwood/inference/commit/2f9b7a4) 3) deploy-manifest-20250210-1822.json (s3://redwood-audit/ci-artifacts/2025/02/10/deploy-manifest-20250210-1822.json) 4) CloudTrail decrypt events (s3://redwood-audit/cloudtrail/2025/02/10/decrypt-events-18-19.json) 5) vuln triage notes (s3://redwood-audit/triage/INFR-991-summary.txt) 6) k8s audit log snippet showing SA binding (s3://redwood-audit/k8s-audit/2025/02/10/sa-binding-1823.json).

sam_sec: Redactions: we redact node hostnames and IPs for customer privacy, but principal ARNs and service account names are preserved. We add a checksum file for each artifact.

auditor_jan: That sounds fine. One more ask: can you also include a short timeline that ties the RBAC change, the deploy, and the decrypt events together (15-30s granularity) so we can show causality?

mike_oncall: Yes. Exporter will generate `timeline.csv` with `_time,artifact,detail`. I'll include the timeline and a short statement signed by oncall certifying the export.

security-bot: Evidence export complete: s3://redwood-audit/evidence/1746051234-bundle.tar.gz (sha256: d2b2...) 

auditor_jan: Received. I'll review and comment tomorrow. If I find anything missing I'll @ you. Thanks all :thumbsup:

sam_sec: quick note for the record — we also kept a forensic snapshot of the pod's env at 18:22 (s3://redwood-audit/forensics/pod-snapshot-20250210-1822.json) in case you need process-level context.

mike_oncall: tagging this thread as resolved for now. reopen if auditor asks for deeper forensics.

auditor_jan: Acknowledged. Thanks everyone.
